case.summary: Cardholder C07297 alerted the bank after disputing an unauthorized $482.12 online purchase under transaction 3476682. Investigation confirmed this charge was part of a rapid 30-minute burst of four online purchases of product C on November 21, 2016, totaling $1,906.07. This cluster sharply deviates from the cardholder's baseline of 194 in-person purchases and only 5 online transactions. The unauthorized transactions were conducted using two new devices, including device D001723 which operated through a transparent proxy and has a history of 30 confirmed fraud cases. The episode is confirmed as card-not-present fraud from new devices, and card C07297-K1 was blocked with a SAR filed.

sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report details card-not-present fraud involving customer C07297 and payment card C07297-K1. On November 21, 2016, between 20:00:00 and 20:30:00, four unauthorized online card-not-present transactions totaling $1,906.07 were processed on card C07297-K1. The transactions comprised transaction 3476602 ($478.95) and transaction 3476682 ($482.12) associated with billing region 264, as well as transaction 3476633 ($456.96) and transaction 3476665 ($488.04) associated with billing region 476, all purchasing product C. On November 22, 2016, customer C07297 contacted the bank to dispute transaction 3476682, confirming that the cardholder never made or authorized the purchase. The cardholder's established transaction history consisted predominantly of 194 in-person purchases and only 5 online authorizations, demonstrating that this rapid sequence of online transactions was highly irregular. The activity was executed using two devices newly introduced to the account, identified as device D000033 and device D001723. Transactions 3476633 and 3476665 were routed through device D001723 via a transparent IP proxy. Internal database records show device D001723 is linked to 30 prior confirmed fraud cases, primarily involving card-not-present fraud from new devices across multiple accounts. Fraud detection model evaluations scored the two transactions originating from device D001723 at elevated risk levels of 0.845 and 0.792. The bank has blocked card C07297-K1 to mitigate ongoing losses, with total suspicious activity amounting to $1,906.07.

stop_reason: Investigation concluded pursuant to policy section 6 because the fraud probability of 88.9% is decisive, supported by multiple independent incriminating bases including direct customer denial, severe behavioral anomaly, and proxy-routed devices with confirmed fraud histories, meaning further inquiries would not alter the decision.
